capabilities: Extract Quran verses from cursor context, selections, and shorthand citations
Search the full corpus by text or Arabic root
Fetch and cache tafsir commentary from 40+ books
Journal reflections, benefits, and notes in per-ayah notes
Link related ayahs and convert orphan Quran passages into ayah-note links
extras: Network is used only for explicit tafsir commands; extraction, search, and journaling work fully offline with no telemetry. Tafsir cache files carry SHA-256 checksums for integrity. Additional docs (source decision, roadmap, vault-note schema) live outside the README, and a video walkthrough is linked. The bundled QPC Hafs v18 font drops U+06DF because it renders unreliably.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to resolve Quran citations, search the corpus by root, or retrieve tafsir commentary, so studying the Quran in notes means manual copying and linking.

relations.evidence: makes outgoing HTTPS requests to tafsir.app (or custom API endpoints configured by the user in Settings)
The bundled Quran corpus is based on Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani, Version 1.1)
Root search uses the Quranic Arabic Corpus morphology data, version 0.4

summary: Quran research toolkit that extracts verses from cursor context, fetches multi-source tafsir, and journals reflections in ayah notes.
